SUMMARY: This factory builds procedural reptiles (Lizard, Frog, Snake, Chameleon) from a genome that assembles part-factories into a tree, then joins, rigs, remeshes, and material-textures the result. The ChameleonFactory specifically instantiates a single `parts.chameleon.Chameleon()` body part (which internally provides the casque crest, coiled tail, cone eyes, split feet) and applies a reptile scale material to give the body its coloured bands. The upper-level files here define the genome assembly, the join/rig/remesh pipeline, animation drivers, and the postprocessing/material assignment; the chameleon geometry itself lives in `parts.chameleon` (not shown among these files).

EDITABLE (upper-level files — change these to alter the result):

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/reptile.py
  chameleon_genome(): builds the Chameleon genome; parts = single `parts.chameleon.Chameleon()` body.
    knobs: open_mouth(U()>0, random unused) -> mouth state; anim=snake_swim_params() -> wiggle animation source (chameleon_eye_params() is defined but not wired in — swap to enable eye motion)
  ChameleonFactory: entry factory for chameleons.
    knobs: max_distance(40) -> cull distance; create_placeholder cube size(1) -> placeholder scale; create_asset uses postprocess_func=reptile_postprocessing, rigging=False, adaptive_resolution=False -> texture + no rig/remesh (note: returns `root`, not `joined`)
  chameleon_postprocessing(body_parts, extras, params): alternate material pass (currently NOT used by ChameleonFactory; reptile_postprocessing is used instead). Uncomment `chameleon_eye.apply(...)` to texture eyes.
  reptile_postprocessing(body_parts, extras, params): assigns materials to all reptiles incl. chameleon.
    knobs: main body material = weighted_sample(material_assignments.reptile)() (random pick, e.g. SnakeScale — controls the coloured band scale look); Tongue()/Bone()(Horn)/Eyeball(coord="X")/Nose() applied by name-match -> per-part materials
  chameleon_eye_params(): eye-turn wiggle params (unused unless wired into anim).
    knobs: swim_freq(0.2*clip_gaussian) -> eye rotation speed; swim_mag(N(20,3)) -> eye rotation amplitude deg; flipper_freq/mag/var -> secondary motion
  snake_swim_params(): body wiggle params used by chameleon anim.
    knobs: swim_freq(2*clip_gaussian(1,0.3,0.1,2)) -> body sway speed; swim_mag(N(200,3)) -> body sway amplitude deg; flipper_freq/mag/var(U(0,0.2)) -> secondary
  animate_chameleon_eye(root, arma, params, ik_targets): drives bones containing "Eye".
    knobs: wavelength(U(0.2,0.4)) -> phase spread; mag_deg/freq from params
  animate_snake_swim(): drives "Body" bones; knobs: wavelength(U(0.2,0.4))
  lizard_genome()/frog_genome()/snake_genome()/dinosaur(): sibling reptile genomes (not chameleon); head_size scale_x/scale_y (N-sampled), eye Radius(N(0.03,0.005)), horn length/rad/thickness (U ranges), n_bones(15), mod width/height(N(1,0.05))
  LizardFactory/FrogFactory/SnakeFactory: sibling factories; SnakeFactory knobs: snake_length(("uniform",0.5,3)), policy speed/step_range(0.2,0.2)/yaw_dist(-7,7), real-unit scale = length/20
  lizard_run_params()/animate_lizard_run(): run-cycle params (swim_mag N(50,3), freq clip_gaussian) — lizard only

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/util/animation/curve_slither.py
  add_curve_slithers(curve, snake_length): builds snake slither wiggle geo-nodes (snake only).
    knobs: Wavelength(snake_length/U(2,4)), Magnitude(snake_length*0.05*N(1,0.2)), MagRandom(U(0,0.7)), Loopyness(0), AltitudeOffset(0.02)
  nodegroup_wiggles/add_wiggles/add_loopbacks: geo-node wiggle graph; knobs: subdivision Level(3), resample divide-by-4, MODULO 4/2 band pattern
  slither_along_path(): knobs: zoff_pct(0.7), twist_mode "Z_UP", linear keyframe interp
  snap_curve_to_floor(): knob: step_height(1)

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/util/animation/run_cycle.py
  animate_run(): quadruped gait; knobs: stride_length(0.7*clip_gaussian*dim.x), spread(clip_gaussian 0.15), stride_height(U(0.15,0.4)), body_height, flap_height(U(0.3,1)), squash_gait_pct(0.1)
  animate_wiggle_bones(): sinusoid bone driver; knobs: mag_deg, freq, wavelength, fixed_head
  animate_running_front_leg/back_leg(): leg drivers; knobs: mag multipliers(3*mag), location z(-0.1)
  foot_path/body_path(): NURBS gait path shape (order_u=3, cyclic)

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/util/joining.py
  join_and_rig_parts(): master pipeline — join meshes, optional rig, remesh, smooth, apply materials.
    knobs: face_size/min_remesh_size(0.01), adapt_mode("remesh"), smooth_joins(True), remove_doubles thresh(0.01/0.001), SUBSURF levels(1), select_large_component thresh(0.9/0.95), roll("GLOBAL_POS_Y")
  compute_joining_effects(): bevel/smooth bridges between parts; driven by att.bridge_rad/smooth_rad (bevel segments=5)

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/util/creature.py
  genome_to_creature(): instantiates part tree, attaches, writes attributes, returns root+parts.
  PartFactory: base for part factories (sample_params/make_part/__call__ rand-interp).
  raycast_surface/apply_attach_transform/attach(): part attachment via raycast; rotation_basis (global/normal/tangent), att.coord (u,v,rad)
  write_local/global_attributes(): tags (body/neck/head/jaw/limb/foot/rigid), skeleton_rad, local_pos, part_idx

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/util/genome.py
  Joint: rest/pose/bounds(deg)/stiffness/stretch -> joint pose & IK limits
  Attachment: coord(u,v,rad)/joint/side/rotation_basis/bridge_rad/smooth_rad -> where & how parts connect
  IKParams: chain_parts/chain_length/rotation_weight/mode(iksolve|pin)/target_size
  part()/attach(): genome tree construction helpers
  interp_* / compute_child_matching: genome interpolation (blend two creatures at t)

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/util/rigging.py
  creature_rig(): builds armature, bones, IK targets, constraints from genome.
    knobs: shoulder_auto_stiffness(0.85), roll type
  get_bone_idxs(): knobs: trim_bounds_child_margin(0.15), rig_reverse_skeleton, rig_extras, connector_collapse_margin_radpct(0.5)
  create_ragdoll(): physics colliders; knobs: min_col_length(0.1), col_joint_margin(0.2), col_radius(0.07), mass(5), angle limits/3

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/util/creature_util.py
  euler/interp_dict/polar_skeleton/offset_center: math & skeleton helpers (part param interpolation, centering)

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/util/join_smoothing.py
  create_bevel_connection/smooth_around_line/compute_intersection_curve: geometry for smooth part joins.
    knobs: bevel segments(9), offset_pct(98), smooth iters(30)/factor(0.9), simplify_thresh(1.5e-2)

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/util/tree.py
  Tree + iter/map/fold/tzip helpers: generic tree traversal used by genome/rig/join

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/parts/__init__.py
  imports part factories incl. `chameleon` (Chameleon body), eye, horn, tail, foot, reptile_detail, head — swap/add entries to change available parts

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/__init__.py
  exports factories; registers LizardFactory/SnakeFactory/FrogFactory (ChameleonFactory defined in reptile.py but not re-exported here)

LINKED TO INFINIGEN (infra — do NOT edit, resolved from the original package):
  assets/objects/creatures/parts/chameleon.py -> (via parts pkg) the actual chameleon geometry: casque crest, coiled tail, cone eyes, split feet
  assets/composition/material_assignments.py -> weighted lists (material_assignments.reptile) of body materials incl. rainbow/scale shaders
  assets/materials/creature/{bone,eyeball,nose,tongue}.py -> per-part shader materials (Horn=Bone, Eyeball, Nose, Tongue)
  assets/materials/* , assets/colors.py -> material node graphs and color palettes
  core/placement/factory.py -> AssetFactory base class (spawn/create lifecycle)
  core/placement/animation_policy.py -> AnimPolicyRandomForwardWalk, bezier path creation for snake locomotion
  core/placement/detail.py -> adapt_mesh_resolution (remesh/subdivide to face_size)
  core/nodes/{node_wrangler,node_utils,node_info}.py -> geometry/shader node construction (used by curve_slither wiggles)
  core/surface.py -> write_attribute / smooth_attribute
  core/util/blender.py -> object/mesh ops (join, modify_mesh, spawn, transforms, modes)
  core/util/math.py -> lerp, clip_gaussian, homogenize, FixedSeed, lerp_sample
  core/util/random.py -> random_general, weighted_sample (material selection, param sampling)
  assets/utils/geometry/lofting.py -> skeleton_to_tangents (raycast surface attachment)
  assets/utils/geometry/nurbs.py, curve.py -> mesh-from-pydata / cylinder topology for bevel joins
